blind.description: A stylized wooden gold mining sluice box. It features a raised rectangular hopper/feed box at the upper end filled with gold nuggets and gravel, connecting to a downward-sloping wooden trough partitioned by transverse wooden riffles holding sediment and gold ore. The channel is supported by three sets of sturdy wooden legs of graduated heights resting directly on the ground. Colors consist of rich brown wood with green edge accents and warm yellow-orange gold nuggets.
blind.from_above: A long rectangular trough segmented into narrow chambers filled with gold ore, anchored at the high end by a square hopper box.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top hopper stands around half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall), sloping down to about 1 ft at the lower end, with a total length of approximately 6 to 7 ft.

notes: Asset is diagonally oriented within its bounding box, giving a wider footprint measurement than its actual long narrow profile.
